text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(...I actually have a present prepared, 
but if I give it to her, it might bring 
her bad luck. So... just my 
congratulations will have to do...)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! Yay, hooray♪ Rice-chan wished me a 
happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hearing 'happy birthday' from you makes me 
suuuper happy, Rice-chan! Say it again♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! R-Really? Ehehe... Happy birthday, 
Urara-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Rice-chan! More! I wanna hear wa~y 
more!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
C-Congratulations...! ...Ugh, this is a 
little embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(She's so happy about it... So Rice can't 
afford to be a scaredy-cat anymore...! I 
have to be brave... and give her my 
present too...!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm... How about we wrap up the 
congratulations and give you a present 
instead... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh!? You're giving me a present tooぉ!? 
Yay yay~! I want it, I want it~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want you to say congratulations 
even more♪ More, more! Moooooore!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan... Hehe, yeah. I'll say it lots 
and lots of times...!
